item.title: Trump administration eases sanctions on Venezuelan oil industry after Maduro’s capture
item.description: The Trump administration announced it is easing up on sanctions and allowing limited Venezuelan oil transactions following the capture of dictator Nicolás Maduro.

item.title: Trump declares national emergency over Cuba, threatens tariffs on nations that supply oil to communist regime
item.description: Trump declared a national emergency over Cuba, accusing the communist regime of aligning with hostile powers and ordering new tariffs on oil suppliers to the island nation.

item.title: Trump warns UK it's 'very dangerous' to do business with China after Starmer's Beijing meeting
item.description: President Trump warned the U.K. it is “very dangerous” to deepen ties with China after PM Keir Starmer met Xi Jinping in Beijing, also cautioning that Canada faces even greater risk.

item.title: Trump says Melania has been 'more outspoken' this term at Trump Kennedy Center documentary premiere
item.description: President Trump and Melania Trump attended the premiere of documentary "MELANIA" at Kennedy Center, set for global theatrical release Jan. 30.

item.title: DHS Secretary Kristi Noem addresses calls for her firing, new Alex Pretti video
item.description: DHS Secretary Kristi Noem faces mounting criticism and impeachment threats from Democrats after federal agents fatally shot two people during immigration crackdown in Minnesota.

item.title: Pennsylvania Gov Josh Shapiro condemns inflammatory ICE rhetoric from DA Larry Krasner as 'abhorrent'
item.description: Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro decried anti-I.C.E. remarks from Philadelphia District Attorney Larry Krasner, telling "Special Report" that such rhetoric is "unacceptable."

item.title: Timberwolves players release statement addressing 'recent tragic events' involving ICE in Minneapolis
item.description: Minnesota Timberwolves players released a statement expressing sympathy for their community amid rising ICE tensions and recent fatal incidents in Minneapolis.

item.title: AOC voices support for anti-ICE shutdown, declines to participate
item.description: Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, D-N.Y., voiced support for a nationwide "shutdown" anti-ICE protest set to take place on Friday but said her congressional office will remain open.
